description:
T0627 Holly - Fell, dead tree.
T4282 Lime - Repollard at historic points to mitigate encroachment and light issues, height to app 12m and radial spread to 4-5 all aspects. Current height 15m, reducing by 3m, and current spread 12m reducing by 7-8m.
T0628 Holly - Fell. Crown in decline and overhangs footpath.
T4182 Carpinus betulus - Crown lift to 2.5m for pedestrian clearance. No change to overall height or spread. Current height 9m and current spread 7m.
T4287 Lime - Repollard At historic points. Height 10m, radial spread 3m all aspects. Current height 14m, reducing by 4m, and current spread 8m reducing by 5m.  
T4286 Lime - Repollard At historic points. Height 10m, radial spread 3m all aspects. Current height 14m reducing by 4m, and current spread 8m reducing by 5m.
T4250 Horse Chestnut - Crown lift to 2.5m over road for pedestrian clearance and 5m over road for vehicle clearance. No change to overall height or spread. Current height 15m and current spread 9m.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: Please provide a clearer location plan as we are unable to view the trees clearly on the current tree location plans.
